content.subject: Fulfillment data reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi AJ,
Your catalog of fulfillment options spans core pick-and-pack, temperature-controlled, and multi-brand 3PL services. Companies that cover that breadth juggle order data from several platforms, which creates a constant need to reconcile inventory across channels. That reconciliation work tends to pull teams away from strategic tasks. We feed each transaction into a unified ledger that updates stock in real time, removing the manual stitching step. Is the time spent reconciling inventory a pain point you’re handling manually?
